entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
I need to return this VeloBand tracker.
I can certainly look into that for you. May I have your name and the order number, please?

Thank you, Alex. I'm pulling up your account now... I see you're one of our VIP members; we really appreciate your business. Now, to make sure I'm helping correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's not broken. It's just... hard to use.
I'm sorry to hear that. What part of the interface are you finding confusing? Sometimes a quick walkthrough can clear things up.
I read the user manual. Frankly, I just expected more. The whole thing is clunky. I just want my money back.
I understand completely. No problem at all. Let me just check the return eligibility for your order. One moment.
Okay, I see the delivery was 19 days ago. And looking at our policy here... yes, you are well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely process that return for you right now.
Fine. So you'll take it back then?

Yes, of course. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm emailing you a prepaid shipping label as we speak. For the inconvenience, and as a thank you for being a VIP customer, I've also added a $25 credit to your VeloFit account.
Whatever. Just make sure the label shows up.
You should receive it within the next five minutes. Once we get the band back at our warehouse, a full refund will be issued. Was there anything else for you today, Alex?
Alright. Well, thank you again for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
